title: The Algebra of compact-open subsets in the spectrum of the ring $C(T)$ for an infinite compact Hausdorff space $T$
summary: For a commutative Bezout ring R, we give a criterion, in terms of colon ideals with principal radical, for the lattice $\mathring{\mathcal{K}}(\mathrm{Spec}(R))$ of compact open subsets of $\mathrm{Spec}(R)$ to be a Heyting algebra. Bezhanishvili and Tressl showed that $\mathring{\mathcal{K}}(\mathrm{Spec}(C(T)))$ is pseudocomplemented whenever T is a basically disconnected compact Hausdorff space, and asked whether $\mathrm{Spec}(C(β\mathbb{N}))$ is actually an Esakia space.
